blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Top-seeded Filipina tennis standout Alex Eala begins her quest for gold in the women’s singles tournament of the Asian Games 2026 on Monday at Nagoya City Higashiyama Park Tennis Center. Following a first-round bye, the world No. 18 Eala faces Thailand’s No. 510 Patcharin Cheapchandej in the second round. The official match time has yet to be set. Eala holds a clear advantage over the 31-year-old Thai, having beaten Cheapchandej, 6-3, 6-4, at the 2022 ITF Thailand 05A event.
